text.tspan: Falcon030 has a new video port connector. This connector
contains all the signals necessary for connection to an analog VGA
monitor as well as an ST or STE compatible color or monochrome
monitor. In addition, it includes the signals necessary for external
GENLOCK devices including an external video dot clock, and
The Falcon030 video connector is a DB19 male. Its pinout is as
